description: Create a new end-to-end encrypted session and become its owner. Returns invite links per role (sender, observer, and runner in execute sessions). Share a link only with whoever should have that role. The owner link is never returned.

approve_runners.description: execute: require the owner to approve each runner (default true).

description.description:
What you are or do, shown to the other participants (default: the
server's --description).

execute.description: Allow running Python on runners (execute mode).

insecure_http_host.description:
A relay host participants may reach over plain http://, such as a
relay's service name inside a cluster. Bearer tokens and transfer
codes then cross that network in the clear; only set it when the
user asks for it.

job_memory_mb.description: execute: job memory limit in MB (default 2048).

job_timeout_s.description: execute: job time limit in seconds (default 60).

network.description: execute: let jobs reach the network (default false).

never_expires.description:
A session that never expires: it lasts until it is closed (if the
relay allows it). Overrides ttl_minutes.

packages.description:
execute: packages jobs may use, e.g. ["pandas"]. An entry may pin the
version every runner uses with a PEP 440 specifier: "cugrid==0.1.0",
"numpy>=1.26,<3". A job's requirements name the package alone.

ttl_minutes.description: Session lifetime in minutes (default 60, at most 30 days).

name: create_session
